itinerary.day_1: Amritsar → Dalhousie (Drive: 230 km · 5 hrs). Places: Dalhousie. Activities: Golden Temple morning visit; Drive via Pathankot; Dalhousie evening arrival.
itinerary.day_2: Dalhousie → Khajjiar → Chamba (Drive: 50 km · 2 hrs). Places: Khajjiar, Chamba Town. Activities: Khajjiar 'Mini Switzerland' meadow; Kalatop Wildlife Sanctuary walk; Chamba town arrival.
itinerary.day_3: Chamba Heritage (Drive: Local). Places: Chamba Town, Chamera Lake. Activities: Lakshmi Narayan Temple complex; Bhuri Singh Museum; Chamera Lake viewpoint.
itinerary.day_4: Chamba → Amritsar (Drive: 230 km · 5 hrs). Activities: Chamunda Devi Temple morning; Scenic highway drive; Amritsar arrival.
